mapper.update: /* User01Mapper.withdrawMyAccount */ UPDATE TB_USER SET USER_ID = #{userCd} , SITE_CD = NULL , NODE_CD = NULL , USER_PW = NULL , MBL_NO_ENC = NULL , MBL_NO_HMAC = NULL , MBL_NO_LAST4 = NULL , EMAIL_ENC = NULL , EMAIL_HMAC = NULL , EMAIL_DOMAIN = NULL , BIRTH_DT_ENC = NULL , GENDER = NULL , WITHDRAWAL_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') , ACCOUNT_STATUS = '03' , USE_YN = 'N' , UPDATE_NO = #{userCd} , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd}
mapper.select: /* User01Mapper.selectMyProfile */ SELECT A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , C.SITE_NM AS siteNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', A.SITE_CD, A.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm , A.MBL_NO_ENC AS mblNo , A.EMAIL_ENC AS email , A.LAST_LOGIN_DTIME AS lastLoginDtime FROM TB_USER A LEFT JOIN TB_SITE C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{gvUserCd}

/* User01Mapper.selectUserServiceCreditList */ SELECT A.CREDIT_ID AS creditId , A.CREDIT_MONTHS AS creditMonths , A.REASON_TYPE AS reasonType , A.REASON_DETAIL AS reasonDetail FROM TB_USER_SERVICE_CREDIT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CREDIT_ID

/* User01Mapper.selectUserHireDateHistory */ SELECT H.HIST_ID AS histId , H.PREV_HIRE_DATE AS prevHireDate , H.NEW_HIRE_DATE AS newHireDate , H.CHANGE_REASON AS changeReason , H.HANDLING_TYPE AS handlingType , H.APPLIED_YN AS appliedYn , DATE_FORMAT(H.APPLIED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS appliedDate , U.USER_NM AS changerNm , DATE_FORMAT(H.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS changedAt FROM TB_USER_HIRE_DATE_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = H.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = H.INSERT_NO WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND H.USER_CD = #{userCd} ORDER BY H.INSERT_DATE DESC, H.HIST_ID DESC
